# Canonical Data Gap Audit

Problem: A team has a dataset or decision problem and needs to know what is missing, conflicted, stale, inaccessible or governance-restricted before trusting analysis built on top of it.
Pricing: No approved fixed machine price/payment path verified. Raven data-product concepts are hypotheses unless separately approved.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public capability: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a961b11776ad5ca30439db3/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=datafoundry-data-gap-audit-machine-v1
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- audit this dataset for gaps
- what data is missing for this decision
- find provenance problems in this data
- reconcile conflicting sources
- where are our visibility gaps
- design a plan to close these data gaps

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
